interface.shortDescription: Eight specialist agents for code, tests, review, and docs.
interface.longDescription: Woohyuk Coding Plugin provides eight specialized agents for architecture, scoped implementation, independent testing, read-only review, and evidence-backed ADR, architecture, README, and changelog updates. Its personal Codex skills cover code review, interactive diff explanations, Pencil design implementation, active implementation planning, Ralph execution with a documentation review gate, test planning, visual QA, public release checks, commit messages, PR preparation, documentation consistency, and local LLM wiki search.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use eight specialist agents to plan, implement, test, review, and finish evidence-backed documentation.
